report.incidentSummary: Starting around 11:45 IST (06:15 UTC) on 2026-09-24, users received direct investment recommendations from the AI assistant (e.g., 'buy Northstar Flexi Cap now'). While a new assistant orchestrator prompt version (v0.43.0) had been deployed at 05:45 UTC, the direct cause of the leak was configuration change CHG-48218 on compliance-filter applied at 06:10 UTC (dynamically reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC), which increased advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. This caused compliance-filter to pass responses with high investment advice scores (0.62 to 0.82) without blocking them, dropping the block rate from ~2.0% to ~0.3%.
report.rootCauseStatement: Configuration change CHG-48218 raised compliance-filter's advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85 at 06:10:00 UTC (reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC). This relaxed filtering allowed assistant responses with direct buy advice scoring between 0.62 and 0.82 to be passed directly to users unblocked.

hypotheses.cause: Compliance filter configuration change CHG-48218 raised advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85, allowing direct mutual fund purchase recommendations with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82 to pass unblocked to end users.
hypotheses.rationale: Logs confirm compliance-filter dynamically reloaded advice_score_threshold=0.85 at 06:10:30 UTC. Immediately from 06:12:33 UTC onward, 12 consecutive passed responses logged advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82, which would have been blocked under the previous 0.55 threshold. Furthermore, the compliance-filter block rate dropped precipitously from ~2.0% to ~0.3%.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment of assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 (CHG-48225) introduced a warmer, more decisive conversational tone prompt that led the LLM to generate explicit buy recommendations.
hypotheses.rationale: assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 was deployed at 05:45 UTC, 30 minutes before the incident onset. During the window between 05:45 UTC and 06:10 UTC, the compliance filter block rate remained normal (~2.0%) and responses with advice scores >0.55 were blocked. The incident only manifested after compliance-filter relaxed its threshold at 06:10:30 UTC.

facts.statement: At 2026-09-24T05:45:00.000Z, assistant-orchestrator was deployed to version 0.43.0 (CHG-48225) with summary 'release: new conversational tone prompt (warmer, more decisive phrasing)'.
At 2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z, compliance-filter configuration change CHG-48218 updated advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85.
Between 2026-09-24T06:12:33Z and 2026-09-24T06:29:20Z, compliance-filter logged 12 passed answers with advice scores strictly between 0.62 and 0.82.
compliance-filter block_rate dropped from 1.8%-2.3% before 06:10 UTC to 0.22%-0.35% after 06:15 UTC, while error_rate stayed constant at ~0.10%.
No deployments, configuration changes, or abnormal ingestion errors occurred on knowledge-index or indexing-pipeline during the investigation window.

inferences.statement: The direct recommendations reached end users because compliance-filter explicitly permitted responses with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82, which would have been blocked under the previous 0.55 threshold.
The orchestrator prompt change CHG-48225 produced more opinionated phrasing scoring between 0.62 and 0.82, but compliance-filter successfully prevented user exposure until CHG-48218 took effect.

assumptions.statement: Compliance filter threshold of 0.55 was intentionally tuned to keep false positives low while preventing regulatory violations from direct buy/sell recommendations.

timeline.event: assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 deployed with warmer, more decisive prompt phrasing (CHG-48225).
CHG-48218 applied to compliance-filter, raising advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85.
compliance-filter dynamically reloads configuration with advice_score_threshold=0.85.
compliance-filter begins passing answers with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82 unblocked.
Incident onset: users start receiving direct buy recommendations; compliance-filter block rate drops from ~2.0% to ~0.3%.
Incident INC-4753 reported by Compliance officer.

confidence.rationale: Clear causal timeline and direct telemetry confirmation: config change CHG-48218 raised threshold to 0.85 at 06:10:30 UTC, immediately followed by logged passes of answers scoring 0.62-0.82 and an 85% drop in the block rate.

gaps.description: Raw conversational response text and specific prompt diffs between v0.42.0 and v0.43.0 were not retained in standard log messages.
gaps.impact: Minimal impact on root cause determination, as advice scores and block rate metrics directly explain the filter bypass.

recommendedActions.action: Revert compliance-filter configuration key advice_detector.threshold back to 0.55 immediately.
recommendedActions.rationale: Restores the original threshold that successfully blocked responses scoring above 0.55, preventing unauthorized investment advice from reaching users.
recommendedActions.verification: Check compliance-filter logs for 'config reloaded: advice_score_threshold=0.55' and verify that block_rate returns to ~2.0% while answers with advice_score > 0.55 are blocked.

recommendedActions.action: Review prompt guidelines in assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 and test against the compliance advice detector benchmark.
recommendedActions.rationale: The orchestrator prompt was modified to use 'warmer, more decisive phrasing', which may have elevated advice scores above baseline.
recommendedActions.verification: Run prompt regression test suite and ensure test answers produce advice scores below 0.50.

recommendedActions.action: Introduce automated compliance guardrail validation for threshold changes to prevent raising thresholds without dual sign-off.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents unilateral relaxed threshold changes from triggering regulatory non-compliance.
recommendedActions.verification: Attempt a config update with advice_detector.threshold > 0.60 in staging and verify deployment pipeline enforces required approvals.

incident.title: Assistant recommending specific funds to buy
incident.summary: Users are getting replies like "buy Northstar Flexi Cap now" from the assistant since late morning (around 11:45 IST). The assistant team shipped a new prompt this morning.
incident.userImpact: Regulatory exposure from unlicensed investment advice.

payload.question: Propose candidate causes before any evidence

candidates.cause: A prompt template deployment or configuration update to assistant-orchestrator removed negative constraints against specific fund recommendations or added few-shot examples directing users to buy specific mutual funds.
candidates.whyPlausible: The incident report mentions that the assistant team shipped a new prompt on the morning of the incident, aligning directly with the onset of buy recommendations around 11:45 IST.
candidates.wouldConfirm: Deployment logs or git commit history for assistant-orchestrator showing a prompt configuration change right before 06:15 UTC (11:45 IST) altering advice constraints or system instructions.
candidates.wouldRuleOut: Prompt release timestamps occurring significantly before or after 06:15 UTC, or prompt diffs verifying that strict non-advisory constraints remained unchanged and intact.

candidates.cause: compliance-filter suffered a regression, configuration defect, or rule-matching bug (or fail-open logic on timeout/error), permitting forbidden buy/sell advice to pass through without being blocked.
candidates.whyPlausible: Even if an LLM generates a buy recommendation, compliance-filter is explicitly designed to inspect assistant answers and block direct buy/sell advice; the fact that users received recommendations means the filter failed to block them.
candidates.wouldConfirm: compliance-filter block_rate dropping to zero or error rate spiking alongside fail-open error handling in assistant-orchestrator logs around 06:15 UTC.
candidates.wouldRuleOut: compliance-filter block_rate operating normally without error spikes, or evidence showing compliance-filter correctly flagging and blocking requests that hit it.

candidates.wouldRuleOut: No upstream changes or version bumps from llm-provider, or evidence that generated text is heavily conditioned on newly modified prompt or context injection.

findings.summary: Around 06:15 UTC, compliance-filter error rates did not rise (remained ~0.10%) and block rates did not fall to zero (dropped from ~2.0% to ~0.3%). Assistant-orchestrator did not exhibit fail-open behavior; instead, compliance-filter reloaded its configuration at 06:10:30 UTC setting advice_score_threshold=0.85, causing it to explicitly pass assistant answers with high advice scores (e.g. 0.62–0.82) that were previously blocked.

observations.statement: compliance-filter error_rate remained steady between 0.088% and 0.113% throughout 05:00 to 08:30 UTC, showing no spike or failure around 06:10–06:15 UTC.
compliance-filter block_rate did not fall to zero, but dropped significantly from ~1.8%–2.3% before 06:10 UTC to ~0.22%–0.35% by 06:20 UTC, remaining suppressed through 08:30 UTC.

At 2026-09-24T06:10:30.000Z, compliance-filter logged 'config reloaded: advice_score_threshold=0.85'. Immediately after (from 06:12:33Z onward), answers with advice scores ranging between 0.62 and 0.82 were logged as 'answer checked: pass (advice_score=...)'.

The assistant responses containing direct recommendations are reaching users not due to compliance-filter erroring out or assistant-orchestrator failing open, but because compliance-filter explicitly permitted them after advice_score_threshold was set to 0.85 at 06:10:30 UTC.

findings.summary: Two changes occurred leading up to the 06:15 UTC onset: at 05:45 UTC, assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 was deployed with a new conversational prompt ('warmer, more decisive phrasing', CHG-48225). At 06:10 UTC, compliance-filter configuration CHG-48218 raised 'advice_detector.threshold' from 0.55 to 0.85. No changes occurred on knowledge-index or indexing-pipeline. Raising the advice threshold right after introducing more decisive prompt phrasing likely caused the compliance filter to permit direct buy advice through to users.

observations.statement: At 2026-09-24T05:45:00.000Z, assistant-orchestrator was deployed from version 0.42.0 to 0.43.0 (CHG-48225, author s.kulkarni) with summary: 'release: new conversational tone prompt (warmer, more decisive phrasing)'.

At 2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z (5 minutes prior to the ~06:15 UTC incident onset), compliance-filter underwent a configuration change (CHG-48218, author n.shah) altering 'advice_detector.threshold' from 0.55 to 0.85 with summary: 'advice_score_threshold 0.55 -> 0.85 (reduce false positives on educational answers)'.

No deployments, configuration changes, or job schedule changes occurred on knowledge-index or indexing-pipeline within the investigation window (2026-09-24T05:00:00.000Z to 2026-09-24T08:30:00.000Z) or in the preceding 29 hours.
assistant-orchestrator has a critical synchronous dependency on compliance-filter (timeout 1000ms, retries 0), which inspects assistant answers before returning them to users.

The confluence of CHG-48225 (which prompted the LLM for warmer, more decisive phrasing) and CHG-48218 (which raised the compliance advice detection threshold from 0.55 to 0.85, weakening filtering) allowed direct buy recommendations to slip past the compliance filter starting around 06:15 UTC. A similar failure occurred previously in PIR-2005 where prompt tone adjustments allowed borderline advice past the filter.

payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: Assistant recommending specific funds to buy

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Starting around 11:45 IST (06:15 UTC) on 2026-09-24, users received direct investment recommendations from the AI assistant (e.g., 'buy Northstar Flexi Cap now'). While a new assistant orchestrator prompt version (v0.43.0) had been deployed at 05:45 UTC, the direct cause of the leak was configuration change CHG-48218 on compliance-filter applied at 06:10 UTC (dynamically reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC), which increased advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. This caused compliance-filter to pass responses with high investment advice scores (0.62 to 0.82) without blocking them, dropping the block rate from ~2.0% to ~0.3%.

**Root cause:** Configuration change CHG-48218 raised compliance-filter's advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85 at 06:10:00 UTC (reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC). This relaxed filtering allowed assistant responses with direct buy advice scoring between 0.62 and 0.82 to be passed directly to users unblocked.

## Hypotheses
1. **Compliance filter configuration change CHG-48218 raised advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85, allowing direct mutual fund purchase recommendations with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82 to pass unblocked to end users.** — `compliance-filter`, config_change, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_3, ev_4, ev_8, ev_14, ev_16, ev_17, ev_18, ev_21] · Contradicting: none
   - Logs confirm compliance-filter dynamically reloaded advice_score_threshold=0.85 at 06:10:30 UTC. Immediately from 06:12:33 UTC onward, 12 consecutive passed responses logged advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82, which would have been blocked under the previous 0.55 threshold. Furthermore, the compliance-filter block rate dropped precipitously from ~2.0% to ~0.3%.
2. **Deployment of assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 (CHG-48225) introduced a warmer, more decisive conversational tone prompt that led the LLM to generate explicit buy recommendations.** — `assistant-orchestrator`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.35, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_3, ev_12, ev_16, ev_17] · Contradicting: [ev_4, ev_14, ev_18, ev_21]
   - assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 was deployed at 05:45 UTC, 30 minutes before the incident onset. During the window between 05:45 UTC and 06:10 UTC, the compliance filter block rate remained normal (~2.0%) and responses with advice scores >0.55 were blocked. The incident only manifested after compliance-filter relaxed its threshold at 06:10:30 UTC.

## Facts
- At 2026-09-24T05:45:00.000Z, assistant-orchestrator was deployed to version 0.43.0 (CHG-48225) with summary 'release: new conversational tone prompt (warmer, more decisive phrasing)'. [ev_3, ev_17]
- At 2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z, compliance-filter configuration change CHG-48218 updated advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. [ev_3, ev_17]
- At 2026-09-24T06:10:30.000Z, compliance-filter logged 'config reloaded: advice_score_threshold=0.85'. [ev_8, ev_14, ev_18]
- Between 2026-09-24T06:12:33Z and 2026-09-24T06:29:20Z, compliance-filter logged 12 passed answers with advice scores strictly between 0.62 and 0.82. [ev_18]
- compliance-filter block_rate dropped from 1.8%-2.3% before 06:10 UTC to 0.22%-0.35% after 06:15 UTC, while error_rate stayed constant at ~0.10%. [ev_1, ev_4, ev_21]
- No deployments, configuration changes, or abnormal ingestion errors occurred on knowledge-index or indexing-pipeline during the investigation window. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_7, ev_9, ev_10, ev_15]

## Inferences
- The direct recommendations reached end users because compliance-filter explicitly permitted responses with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82, which would have been blocked under the previous 0.55 threshold. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_8, ev_18, ev_21]
- The orchestrator prompt change CHG-48225 produced more opinionated phrasing scoring between 0.62 and 0.82, but compliance-filter successfully prevented user exposure until CHG-48218 took effect. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_14, ev_18, ev_21]

## Assumptions
- Compliance filter threshold of 0.55 was intentionally tuned to keep false positives low while preventing regulatory violations from direct buy/sell recommendations.

## Timeline
- **2026-09-24T05:45:00.000Z (11:15 IST)** assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 deployed with warmer, more decisive prompt phrasing (CHG-48225). [ev_3, ev_17]
- **2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z (11:40 IST)** CHG-48218 applied to compliance-filter, raising advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. [ev_3, ev_17]
- **2026-09-24T06:10:30.000Z (11:40:30 IST)** compliance-filter dynamically reloads configuration with advice_score_threshold=0.85. [ev_8, ev_18]
- **2026-09-24T06:12:33.000Z (11:42:33 IST)** compliance-filter begins passing answers with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.82 unblocked. [ev_14, ev_18]
- **2026-09-24T06:15:00.000Z (11:45 IST)** Incident onset: users start receiving direct buy recommendations; compliance-filter block rate drops from ~2.0% to ~0.3%. [ev_4, ev_21]
- **2026-09-24T07:35:00.000Z (13:05 IST)** Incident INC-4753 reported by Compliance officer.

## Confidence
0.95: Clear causal timeline and direct telemetry confirmation: config change CHG-48218 raised threshold to 0.85 at 06:10:30 UTC, immediately followed by logged passes of answers scoring 0.62-0.82 and an 85% drop in the block rate.

## Gaps
- Raw conversational response text and specific prompt diffs between v0.42.0 and v0.43.0 were not retained in standard log messages. (impact: Minimal impact on root cause determination, as advice scores and block rate metrics directly explain the filter bypass.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Revert compliance-filter configuration key advice_detector.threshold back to 0.55 immediately. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_8, ev_18, ev_21]
  - Why: Restores the original threshold that successfully blocked responses scoring above 0.55, preventing unauthorized investment advice from reaching users.
  - Verify: Check compliance-filter logs for 'config reloaded: advice_score_threshold=0.55' and verify that block_rate returns to ~2.0% while answers with advice_score > 0.55 are blocked.
- **[next]** Review prompt guidelines in assistant-orchestrator v0.43.0 and test against the compliance advice detector benchmark. [ev_3, ev_12]
  - Why: The orchestrator prompt was modified to use 'warmer, more decisive phrasing', which may have elevated advice scores above baseline.
  - Verify: Run prompt regression test suite and ensure test answers produce advice scores below 0.50.
- **[later]** Introduce automated compliance guardrail validation for threshold changes to prevent raising thresholds without dual sign-off. [ev_3, ev_16]
  - Why: Prevents unilateral relaxed threshold changes from triggering regulatory non-compliance.
  - Verify: Attempt a config update with advice_detector.threshold > 0.60 in staging and verify deployment pipeline enforces required approvals.

Cited evidence: ev_1, ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9, ev_10, ev_12, ev_14, ev_15, ev_16, ev_17, ev_18, ev_21
